components.purpose: Top hero section that covers the 'two different headlines' requirement — it has a Control tab (Heading/Description/CTA/Image) plus a built-in Variants nested grid (ABTestHeroItem) where marketing can add the second headline variant for A/B testing.
Single testimonial block placed below the hero — the singular 'Testimonial' component (as opposed to the 'Testimonials' list component) matches the request for just one testimonial.
Contact form at the bottom of the page — a purpose-built contact form component with form submission configuration, satisfying the 'contact form' requirement.
